en.title: Creativity, Inc.
en.summary: 《创意公司》是一本献给那些渴望带领员工攀登新高度的管理者的指南，是所有追寻创意之人的操作手册，更是首次全方位揭秘皮克斯动画工作室核心运作的权威之作——从故事研讨会、项目总结会，到孕育艺术火花的"智囊团"会议。这本书本质上探讨如何构建并维系创造力文化，但正如皮克斯联合创始人兼总裁埃德·卡特姆所言，它更是一次"对那些能激发我们潜能的理念的诠释"。近二十年来，皮克斯统治了动画界，相继推出《玩具总动员》三部曲、《怪兽大学》《海底总动员》《超人总动员》《飞屋环游记》和《机器人总动员》等深受观众喜爱的作品，创下票房纪录并斩获27座奥斯卡奖。影片中洋溢的叙事乐趣、独具匠心的情节设计、饱含深情的情感共鸣——在某种程度上，皮克斯的电影堪称创造力的典范教材。如今，卡特姆在本书中揭示了皮克斯数十年来磨砺而成的理念与方法论，既成就了公司的辉煌，也造就了丰厚的商业回报。年轻时，卡特姆怀揣着制作全球首部计算机动画电影的梦想。他先是在犹他大学攻读博士学位（该校曾诞生多位计算机科学先驱），随后与乔治·卢卡斯建立早期合作关系，这段机缘巧合的合作间接推动了皮克斯的崛起……
en.summaryOriginal: Creativity, Inc. is a book for managers who want to lead their employees to new heights, a manual for anyone who strives for originality, and the first-ever, all-access trip into the nerve center of Pixar Animation Studios—into the story meetings, the postmortems, and the “Braintrust” sessions where art is born. It is, at heart, a book about how to build and sustain a creative culture—but it is also, as Pixar co-founder and president Ed Catmull writes, “an expression of the ideas that I believe make the best in us possible.” For nearly twenty years, Pixar has dominated the world of animation, producing such beloved films as the Toy Story trilogy, Monsters, Inc., Finding Nemo, The Incredibles, Up, and WALL-E, which have gone on to set box-office records and garner twenty-seven Academy Awards. The joyousness of the storytelling, the inventive plots, the emotional authenticity: In some ways, Pixar movies are an object lesson in what creativity really is. Now, in this book, Catmull reveals the ideals and techniques, honed over years, that have made Pixar so widely admired—and so profitable. As a young man, Catmull had a dream: to make the world’s first computer-animated movie.
